steps.description: `Promise.all` runs two independent calls together: `getAICommentary` for the move and `getAIElo` for a fresh estimate. The page says they do not depend on each other, so the app fires them together and waits once.
Destructure the two results, then store them with `setCommentary` and `setEloEstimate`.

title: Two AI Calls at Once
